analysis.title: Prime HFs Update - Nov 5th at US Close
key_insights: At the US close on Nov 5, GS estimates Global Fundamental LS managers fell 1.3% (a -2 SD move), driven mainly by market/beta exposure. YTD performance is +8.7%.
TMT funds fell more than 4% and are now roughly flat to slightly positive YTD, down from about +24% before the June/July AI sell-off.
US-focused fundamental funds fell 1.7% and are up 5.5% YTD.
Systematic LS managers rose 0.2%, with gains in the U.S. and EM Asia offsetting losses in Europe and DM Asia. They are up 16% YTD.
Multi-Strats fell 1.4%, driven by the sell-off in high-beta names, Info Tech, and Momentum (down 3.7 SD), plus negative idiosyncratic returns.

On Nov 4, broader markets rose but a semis-to-software rotation drove a sharp US momentum sell-off. Systematic L/S ended slightly up as EM Asia gains offset U.S. losses, global fundamentals rose with the market rally, and multi-strategy funds were modestly lower.

Intraday on Nov 5 (about 10:30 EST), US markets sold off and global momentum fell. Fundamental funds were down, with US-focused funds hit harder, TMT funds fell sharply, systematic funds were positive, and multi-strategy funds fell significantly on equity exposure.
risk_factors: Broad US equity sell-off with high-beta, Info Tech and momentum exposures hit hardest.
Fund performance in TMT has given back most of its YTD gains since the June/July AI sell-off.
vol_and_positioning: Global Fundamental LS managers fell 1.3% on Nov 5, a -2 SD move, mostly from market/beta exposure.
TMT funds fell more than 4% on Nov 5 and are roughly flat to slightly positive YTD, versus about +24% before the June/July AI sell-off.
Momentum factor fell 3.7 SD on Nov 5, hitting multi-strategy funds along with high-beta names and Info Tech.
On Nov 4, a semis-to-software rotation drove a sharp US momentum sell-off even as broader markets rose.
